header.one_line: Himachal Pradesh, up the Sutlej through Kinnaur, along the Spiti river and over Kunzum La to Manali

rules.title: Kinnaur and Spiti: no permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Indian citizens ride through with a photo identity card, shown at check posts. The district page asks every visitor to carry identity. No separate order was found.
rules.set_by: Not stated on an official page; reported by a rider blog

rules.title: Protected area permit for foreign citizens, Pooh to Kaza
rules.detail: Covers Pooh block villages in Kinnaur and the Sumdo, Tabo and Kaza stretch. Kinnaur's page says groups of two, thirty days, Rs 200 each. Lahaul and Spiti's page says four.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs; issued by District Magistrates and Sub-Divisional Magistrates

source.title: Tourist Guidelines, District Kinnaur

rules.title: Kinnaur: carry identity; border roads are out of bounds
rules.detail: Every visitor carries a valid identity card. Roads towards Shipki La and Kaurik are closed to visitors, and security installations may not be photographed.

rules.title: Lahaul and Spiti: online vehicle registration (e-Aagman)
rules.detail: The state portal says vehicles entering the district apply for an e-pass. It names no fee and does not mention two-wheelers. Enforcement in 2026 was not confirmed.
rules.applies_to: All vehicles entering Lahaul and Spiti

rules.detail: For tourist vehicles going over the pass: 800 petrol and 400 diesel permits a day, vehicles under ten years old, valid one day. The official page does not mention two-wheelers.

gaps: Himachal entry toll: the two-wheeler exemption rests on a newspaper report of the Chief Minister's statement (26 March 2026). The official Toll Policy 2026-27 document on hptax.gov.in failed to open (certificate error), so it is not confirmed for motorcycles registered in other states.
No source says on which date motorcycles were first allowed over Kunzum La in 2023, 2025 or 2026; reports name only four-wheel-drive vehicles.
Kunzum La 2021, 2022 and 2023 dates rest partly on one blog table; no newspaper or official page was found for the 2021 opening, 2021 closing or 2023 closing.
The two district pages disagree on the minimum group size for foreign citizens (two in Kinnaur, four in Lahaul and Spiti); no dated order was found for either.
Whether e-Aagman registration is enforced for motorcycles in 2026 was not confirmed.
Spiti barrier fee: no official page found; amount left out.
Manali green tax: amount for two-wheelers is reported by a newspaper only, so it is left out.

Rohtang permit: the official pages list fees for cars, jeeps and buses only; whether two-wheelers need a permit or pay is not stated. That the Atal Tunnel route needs no permit comes from an operator guide.
Videos: titles and channels were read from the video pages; filming dates and motorcycles are not confirmed unless the title states them.
